name: dbx-notebook
description: Open Databricks .py source notebooks in the native notebook UI and run cells on a cluster.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p src/tableViz/tsconfig.core.json && tsc -p src/tableViz/tsconfig.host.json && tsc -p src/tableViz/tsconfig.webview.json && tsc -p test/tableViz/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node test/format.test.js && node test/client.test.js && LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 node --test "test/tableViz/unit/*.test.ts" "dist/test/*.test.cjs"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e

dbxNotebook.autoOpen.description: Open .py files that start with '# Databricks notebook source' in the notebook UI automatically.

dbxNotebook.host.description: Databricks workspace URL. Leave empty to use DATABRICKS_HOST, the Databricks extension's project settings, or ~/.databrickscfg.

dbxNotebook.profile.description: Profile in ~/.databrickscfg to read the host and token from. Defaults to DATABRICKS_CONFIG_PROFILE, then DEFAULT.

dbxNotebook.clusterId.description: Cluster that runs notebook cells. Leave empty to choose with 'Databricks Notebook: Select Cluster'.

dbxNotebook.cliPath.description: Path to the Databricks CLI, used for OAuth login when no token is configured. Defaults to the CLI bundled with the Databricks extension, then 'databricks' on PATH.

dbxNotebook.tableViz.defaultBins.markdownDescription: The number of bins of a new histogram in "Visualize Table". You can change the number on each card.

dbxNotebook.tableViz.topValues.markdownDescription: The number of values in the bar chart of a category column in "Visualize Table". The chart shows the other values as one bar, "Other".
